description: Star Harvest is a 90-second canvas arcade run: pilot a small ship, gather drifting star sparks, dodge polygon rocks, and chain quick pickups into a combo multiplier.
devlog: The arcade starts with restraint: one canvas, one script, no dependencies. Star Harvest draws every sprite procedurally each frame, so there are no image assets to audit and nothing to download. The combo multiplier is the only system beyond steer, collect and dodge, and it teaches the whole game: quick pickups raise the stakes, a hit or a slow gap resets them. Timing runs on requestAnimationFrame with a capped delta and a fixed pool of particles, and the palette is read from the site tokens at boot so both themes stay correct without extra rules.
pitch: Pilot a little ship, gather drifting stars and dodge the rocks. Chain quick pickups to grow your combo.
title: Star Harvest
